Ui_EngineDescription: The Nemotron 3.5 speech model (about 0.74 GB) and a small NVIDIA component. Runs on this PC; nothing else to install.
Ui_AccelerationExpectedGpu: Will try the graphics card (GPU). The one actually used shows after the first transcription.
Ui_LiveTranscriptionDescription: Shows captions on screen while you record. The saved transcript is always made from the recording after you stop; turning this off skips only the live preview.
Ui_LiveNeedsEngine: Download the transcription engine to use this.
Ui_SpeakerLabelsDescription: Labels up to four voices as Speaker 1 to 4. Needs a small extra model (about 0.14 GB) and uses more of the PC while transcribing.
